rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「비영리민간단체 지원법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Support for Non-Profit, Non-Governmental Organizations and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(사업 평가의 항목) 「비영리민간단체 지원법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제9조제2항에 따른 사업 평가의 항목은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2017. 7. 26., 2023. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Items for Project Evaluation) The items for project evaluation pursuant to Article 9(2) of the Act on Support for Non-Profit, Non-Governmental Organizations (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 「비영리민간단체 지원법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제11조제1호에 따른 사업추진 실적 및 성과
rows.text_en: 1. Project implementation performance and results pursuant to Article 11, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Support for Non-Profit Private Organizations (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”)

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제11조제2호에 따른 자체평가 내용의 적정성
rows.text_en: 2. Appropriateness of the contents of the self-evaluation pursuant to Article 11 , Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 3. 영 제11조제3호에 따른 사업비 지출에 대한 회계보고의 적정성
rows.text_en: 3. Appropriateness of accounting reports regarding project expenditures pursuant to Article 11 , Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 행정안전부장관, 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도지사 또는 특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)나 「지방자치법」 제198조제2항제1호에 따른 인구 100만 이상 대도시(이하 “특례시”라 한다)의 장이 사업 평가를 위해 필요하다고 정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters determined by the Minister of the Interior and Safety, the Mayor of a Special City, Metropolitan City, or Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Province, or the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “City/Provincial Governor”), or the head of a large city with a population of 1 million or more pursuant to Article 198, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Local Autonomy Act (hereinafter referred to as “Special Status City”) as necessary for project evaluation

rows.source_ko: 제3조(사업 평가의 절차 등) ① 법 제9조제2항에 따른 사업 평가는 다음 각 호의 순서에 따라 한다.
rows.text_en: ① Project evaluation pursuant to Article 9(2) of the Act shall be conducted in the order of the following subparagraphs.
1. Establishment of Evaluation Plan
2. Notification of evaluation schedule and method
3. Written investigation and on-site investigation (including interviews with relevant parties)
4. Notification of Evaluation Results

rows.source_ko: 5. 평가결과에 대한 의견 제출 및 제출 의견에 대한 검토결과 통지
rows.text_en: 5. Submission of opinions on evaluation results and notification of review results regarding submitted opinions
6. Analysis of Evaluation Results
7. Disclosure of evaluation results

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항제4호에 따라 평가결과를 통지받은 비영리민간단체는 같은 항 제5호에 따라 평가결과에 대한 의견을 제출하려는 경우 그 평가결과를 통지받은 날부터 20일 이내에 행정안전부장관, 시ㆍ도지사나 특례시의 장에게 의견을 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 7. 26., 2023. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② If a non-profit private organization that has been notified of the evaluation results pursuant to Subparagraph 4 of Paragraph 1 intends to submit an opinion on the evaluation results pursuant to Subparagraph 5 of the same Paragraph, it shall submit such opinion to the Minister of the Interior and Safety, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Head of a Special City within 20 days from the date of receiving the notification of the evaluation results. <Amended July 26, 2017; May 1, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 행정안전부장관, 시ㆍ도지사나 특례시의 장은 제1항제5호 및 제2항에 따라 비영리민간단체가 의견을 제출한 경우 그 의견을 접수한 날부터 60일 이내에 검토결과를 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 7. 26., 2023. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of the Interior and Safety, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Head of a Special City shall notify the results of the review within 60 days from the date of receipt of an opinion submitted by a non-profit private organization pursuant to Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 5 and Paragraph 2. <Amended July 26, 2017; May 1, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(평가결과등의 공개) ① 행정안전부장관, 시ㆍ도지사나 특례시의 장은 법 제9조제1항에 따라 비영리민간단체가 제출한 사업보고서의 주요 내용과 제2조 및 제3조에 따라 실시한 평가결과(이하 “평가결과등”이라 한다)를 다음 회계연도 4월 30일까지 행정안전부, 특별시ㆍ광역시ㆍ특별자치시ㆍ도ㆍ특별자치도나 특례시의 인터넷 홈페이지에 각각 공개하여야 한다. 이 경우 행정안전부장관, 시ㆍ도지사나 특례시의 장이 비영리민간단체 지원사업을 관리하기 위하여 구축한 별도의 인터넷 홈페이지가 있는 경우에는 그 인터넷 홈페이지에도 공개하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 7. 26., 2023. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Disclosure of Evaluation Results, etc.) ① The Minister of the Interior and Safety, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Head of a Special City shall, in accordance with Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act, disclose the main contents of business reports submitted by non-profit private organizations and the evaluation results conducted pursuant to Articles 2 and 3 (hereinafter referred to as “evaluation results, etc.”) on the respective internet websites of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Province, Special Self-Governing Province, or Special City by April 30 of the next fiscal year. In this case, if the Minister of the Interior and Safety, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Head of a Special City has established a separate internet website to manage support projects for non-profit private organizations, such information shall also be disclosed on that website. <Amended July 26, 2017; May 1, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 공개하는 평가결과등에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2017. 7. 26., 2023. 5. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The evaluation results, etc. disclosed pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall include the matters of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jul. 26, 2017; May 1, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해당 비영리민간단체가 수행한 공익사업의 목적 및 내용
rows.text_en: 1. Purpose and content of public interest projects carried out by the relevant non-profit private organization
2. Project implementation results compared to the project plan in the business proposal
3. Project implementation results pursuant to Article 2 , Subparagraph 1
4. Details of project expenditures pursuant to Article 11 , Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree
5. Evaluation results pursuant to Articles 2 and 3
6. Comprehensive opinion of the Minister of the Interior and Safety, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Head of a Special City
ADDENDA <Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs Decree No. 35, Sep. 7, 2015>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of the Interior and Safety Decree No. 1, July 26, 2017> (Enforcement Rule on the Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.text_en: 13. Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on Support for Non-Profit Private Organizations is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제2조제4호, 제3조제2항ㆍ제3항, 제4조제1항 전단ㆍ후단 및 같은 조 제2항제6호 중 “행정자치부장관”을 각각 “행정안전부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 2, subparagraph 4; Article 3, paragraphs 2 and 3; the first and second parts of Article 4, paragraph 1; and subparagraph 6 of paragraph 2 of the same article, “Minister of Government Administration and Home Affairs” shall be changed to “Minister of Public Administration and Security”.
